title: Artist Rendering of 'Large, Fiery Orb' seen by federal agents at dusk, Western U.S.
description: Presentation slide titled "Large, Fiery Orb" (Location: Western U.S.; Time of Day: Dusk) with a small image at upper right captioned "Artist Rendering", showing a glowing red-orange sphere with lighter streaks. The bullet text says two federal law enforcement special agents (USPER5 and USPER6) saw a glowing orange orb "approximately 500-600 meters" away, close to a rock pinnacle, which hovered silently for "about a minute." Footnotes say AARO measurements later put the object at ~1050 meters away and 12-18 meters in diameter.
